source: docs/research/reports/14-level2-layout.md Tasks and Map variants; the map variants M22 to M24 are prop states: the pulled fuse (one empty slot, red lamp; the hero does not get it, user) turns the barrier (col 99) off and pulls the bridge (col 52 blocker), the fitted fuse turns both back on; the fuse fits only once the target teleport is repaired, so the barrier never comes back while the linked teleports cannot carry the hero west (overrides the original early fit and its soft-lock, user 2026-11-03); fitting it links the teleports; a refused use adds flag:refused:<object>, so the teleport quest follows a refused fit, not the pull itself
